metadata.title: Drivers, pedagogical uses, and barriers of teachers’ AI adoption: Cross-national evidence from TALIS 2024

design_fields.q1_rationale: The study uses TALIS data, which does not provide plausible values in the same way as PISA/TIMSS, making PV handling not applicable.
design_fields.q2_rationale: The study explicitly states that teacher sampling weights were applied in both descriptive statistics and regression analyses.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study adjusted standard errors for clustering at the school level, ensuring robust statistical inference.
design_fields.q4_rationale: The study performed only internal validation through regression models and did not mention any external validation strategies.
